regime_context: The TSX thematic detector shows Big Banks as the dominant leader with full breadth, high durability, but crowded. The market is in a broad rotation with no single narrative dominating. The only validated edge is the absolute-trend gate (drawdown reduction), which is active and has historically helped cut drawdowns in this market. Cross-sectional momentum is a focus lens only (rank-IC ~0), and the track record is small (n=3) with poor directional accuracy—overall conviction must remain low.

theses.subject: Big Banks
theses.thesis: Banks are eligible under the absolute-trend gate, which is the only validated risk-control edge. Full breadth (1.0) and a durability bar of 0.74 suggest the trend structure is intact and the theme is less prone to large drawdowns. Crowding (z=1.33) is a size cap, not a fade. The lean is a risk-based tilt, not a return forecast.
evidence: Rotation leader with broad eligible count
theses.dissent: Crowding may limit upside; momentum rank has no predictive power, and macro flows (AI/tech frenzy) could rotate away from financials.

falsifier.text: If Big Banks loses eligibility (trend gate breaks) or its durability bar falls below 0.5, the risk-control premise is invalidated.

theses.subject: Utilities & Renewables
theses.thesis: Utilities & Renewables is eligible, not crowded, with a durability bar of 0.65 and decent breadth (0.846). The validated drawdown-reduction property of the trend gate makes it a favorable candidate for smoother price action. This is a risk-management lean, not an alpha call.
theses.dissent: Lower durability than Banks; sensitive to rate rises even if technicals look benign; middling momentum could reverse harmlessly.

falsifier.text: If Utilities & Renewables loses eligibility (trend gate turns false) or breadth declines below 0.5, the rationale breaks.

theses.subject: Gold Miners
theses.thesis: Gold Miners is ineligible (trend gate not met), with extremely low durability (0.27) and very thin breadth (0.062). This signals a high-risk environment for long exposure; the only validated edge (trend gate) does not support participation. Avoidance is warranted until the gate reactivates.
theses.dissent: Gold could spike on geopolitical shocks (unscheduled share 0.93), triggering a sharp reversal that invalidates the gate-based avoidance.

falsifier.text: If Gold Miners becomes eligible (trend gate turns positive) and breadth expands above 0.4, the avoidance thesis would be reconsidered.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
